order: Packet SHA256 order, Gemini then Grok per packet; all first calls followed by exact observed-partial repeats. No score-based early stop or selection.
gate: Complete all 24 valid judgments; all 32 known first-pass criterion statuses match the author hypotheses, and all 8 repeated criterion statuses match their first assessments. The four exploratory first judgments have no expected status and are reported separately. Passing only permits design of a separate full-score repeat experiment; it is neither clinical approval nor automatic permission for more calls.
score_policy: No numerical score, critical-error penalty, weights, pass threshold or candidate-model ranking. Preserve historical S26-S29 and default judging.
stop_policy: Stop at the first transport, response validation or exact-model mismatch; save a contiguous prefix and never retry, repair, resume or pool the run. A process interruption is incomplete, not a fresh call allowance.
